name: melody
does: The music's melodies and basslines by the old rules (old: the seeded walk and the one-bar basslines), the composer's planned phrases (lyrical; new the same) or its riffs and hooks (dance, the default), to A/B. Sets tuning music.melody.
decision: The composer writes the melodies and basslines (Ed, 2026-11-08: "smarter rules"), dancing (Ed, the same day: "more lyrical but not very dancey"); the lyrical way and the old rules kept to A/B
